description: Each case makes its folders, each inside the one before, and a channel in the last one, then expects the path of the channel. So that names stay unique, a spec puts the first folder inside a folder of its own and expects the name of that folder and a '.' before the path, and it adds one suffix to the name of the channel and to the end of the path. A case with no folders makes its channel at the top. The Core's path spec and the TypeScript client's path spec both run these cases.

cases.name: folders whose names hold spaces and symbols
folders whose names hold letters of other scripts
